interface.longDescription: Use the text tools from painintheagent.com with your account key. Remove text watermarks, humanize drafts, compare versions or check AI writing. Rewrites use the characters of the $5 monthly plan (100,000 a month, shared with the website); comparisons and AI checks are free within 100 a day. Results do not prove authorship, and complete watermark removal cannot be verified.
